resources.string: Ereka sikuriini eyakire omu mwirima kakye ngu %1$s ebaase kushoma obu otarikukozesa simu. Kirungi giheke aha chaaja. Simu eguma etakingirwe yaaba neekora, n\'ahabw\'ekyo kikore aharikwesigwa honka.
Teeri kwongyerwamu muriro. Erahuka yaaba eri aha chaaja.
Sikuriini eguma eyakire kandi simu eguma etakingirwe obu %1$s erikushoma. Gitsigye aharikwesigwa honka.
%1$s yaashoma fayiro zaawe zoona. Sherura neezimanya hati.
Batiri eri ahansi ya 20 ya buli kikumi. Heeka chaaja, rero otandikye buto kuruga aha sikuriini y\'amagyenda.
Simu yaayota munonga, n\'ahabw\'ekyo %1$s yaarekyeraho ngu ebaase kwohora. Noobaasa kutandika buto bwanyima.
Garuramu chaaja, rero otandikye buto kuruga aha sikuriini y\'amagyenda.
Aha batiri, %1$s ekora omurimo omworobi gwonka, kandi ogwo guhwire. Heeka chaaja, rero otandikye buto.
Igura sikuriini y\'amagyenda omu %1$s kureeba ensonga n\'okugumizamu.
Sikuriini hati neeyija kuzima yenka nk\'oku yaabaire neekora.
